definition.advancers: count of constituents (per that day's point-in-time HSI membership) with close_t > close_{t-1}
definition.adv_ratio: advancers / (advancers+decliners+unchanged), i.e. equal-name breadth, NOT weighted
definition.pct_above_ma20: fraction of constituents with close_t above their own 20-session simple moving average (continuous price series, independent of index membership gaps)
definition.missing_symbols: constituents in that day's official membership with no usable price row (no previous close, delisted, late listing, data gap) -- excluded from counts, not treated as flat
definition.compatibility_note: Field names chosen to be mergeable with investment/chart/hsi-participation.json's metrics.advances/declines/unchanged (that file is a single as_of snapshot using *official* weighted/capped index-point data; this file is a daily equal-name close-to-close time series, a different and complementary measure, not a replacement).

price_sources.futu_opend_evaluation: Attempted first per project convention (read-only OpenQuoteContext.request_history_kline, no login/trade). Local OpenD historical-K quota/rate-limit rejected most of the universe within this task's time budget ('获取历史K线频率太高' / quota errors), so Yahoo+Tencent was used for the full dataset instead. No trading/account functions were touched.

survivorship_bias_note: Membership is point-in-time (9 versions, 2024-10-01..2026-10-09), so additions/removals are reflected on their actual effective dates -- this avoids survivorship bias in universe membership. However, PRICE history for constituents is only fetched for codes that are current-OR-ever HSI members within this window; a name removed from HSI before 2024-10-01 and never re-added is NOT in this dataset even for dates before its removal would have mattered (out of window, not applicable here). Corporate actions (splits/rights issues) are handled via Yahoo's unadjusted close for the primary feed -- NOT adjusted for splits; large jumps around corporate actions should be treated with caution and are not corrected here.
